'''Commander Anashya Starfall''' is a [[night elf]] quest giver located in [[Thalanaar]] in [[Feralas]]. She has been banished by General [[Shandris Feathermoon]] for insubordination, though the rest of her squad followed her to Thalanaar.

==Quests==
* {{questlong|Alliance|28|The Galak Messenger}} {{queststartfinish}}
* {{questlong|Alliance|28|Shame Never Again}} {{queststartfinish}}
* {{questlong|Alliance|42|Woodpaw Disarray}} {{queststartfinish}}
* {{questlong|Alliance|42|The Grimtotem Plot}} {{queststartfinish}}
* {{questlong|Alliance|42|The Word of the Archdruid}} {{queststart}}

==Quotes==
;Gossip
An outsider approaches.

Welcome to Thalanaar. I am Commander Anashya Starfall.

I have been banished by my own General for what she considers insubordination, though she clearly underestimated the loyalty of my squad. Now we find ourselves here, cast aside by our own leaders who have lost sight of what truly matters - the safety of our people and the preservation of our ancestors' legacy.

For millennia, the Night Elves have held dominion over these lands, and we shall continue to do so until the end of time. Do I make myself clear?

Excellent. Let us proceed.
